eng-prod-bot: [ALERT] Pager: EU canary error-rate spike after weight flip to 'green' — 10:42 UTC. 5xx rate 8.7% (baseline ~0.2%). Trigger: canary-health-checks > threshold. @channel
jamie: seeing the spike in the dashboard, pulling logs now
mike: taking pager, i'm oncall. what's the rollout id?
sara: rollout id deploy/feature/green-2026-03-17-v3 (d4f8c). pushed at 10:38 UTC. I can start rollback if we decide
anya: if rollback will take a few mins, faster mitigation is revert DNS weight to blue + kill feature flag. which path is faster?
mike: DNS weight revert + flag kill seems fastest. @carlos can you revert weights for EU to blue=100?
carlos: doing weight revert now via edgectl:
```
edgectl set-weight --region eu --service inference --variant blue --weight 100
```
edgectl: accepted, change-id ch_98b, propagating to edge nodes (3 shards)
eng-prod-bot: config change ch_98b recorded, propagation started to edge nodes
sara: i'll prep rollback in parallel: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference -n eu --to-revision=2` — starting now
sara: kubectl: rollout undo started, pausing new replicaset termination for observation
monitor: EU 5xx dropping from 8.7% -> 4.1% after weight change (10:46 UTC)
jamie: feature flag ff_green_llm toggled OFF via flags-toggles service at 10:47 UTC
jamie: `flags toggler off ff_green_llm --env=eu` -> OK
anya: good. support — should we page customers or update status page?
mike: preliminary customer impact estimate: ~8% of EU requests returned 5xx between 10:42-10:54 UTC (~12m). Most clients retried; two enterprise tenants (acct: acme-corp, acct: beta-saas) saw correlated latency/error spikes around 10:46-10:52. opening incident ticket INC-7823 and notifying CSMs now
sara: rollback finished, pods stable on v2, healthchecks green. kube reports 0 unavailable pods
eng-prod-bot: post-change metrics: EU 5xx = 0.12% at 10:52 UTC, latency back to baseline
mike: handing on-call to @anya for postmortem follow-up and tracking. I'm signing off from pager. summary: weight flip to green caused regression in inference pipeline (memory exhaustion in variant v3) -> revert weights + kill flag -> rollback as fallback -> resolved
anya: taking handoff. I'll collect logs, trace KV cache behavior, and schedule a blameless postmortem/bridge in 30m. action items: validate pre-flip probe, add short TTL for weight flips, add canary-scale limits.
support-bot: updating status page: partial EU errors -> RESOLVED. Notifying affected customers per INC-7823
jamie: add test for DNS weight reversion path to our runbook. thanks team :white_check_mark:
